Utility Types TypeScript provides several utility types to facilitate common type transformations. These utilities are available globally. Awaited<Type> Released: 4.5 This type is meant to model operations like await in async functions, or the .then() method on Promise s - specifically, the way that they recursively unwrap Promise s. Example ts type A = Awaited < Promise < string >>; type A = string   type B = Awaited < Promise < Promise < number >>>; type B = number   type C = Awaited < boolean
